title: Customer Intelligence data
description: The top-10 accounts' revenue, plan and forecast, pipeline, contracts, device footprint, market and account signals, and briefing insights: the contract views behind Customer Intelligence (data/contract.md). In dev workspaces every row is synthetic.
instructions: These views are the data behind the Customer Intelligence briefing. Use the definitions below so answers match it.
The top 10 are the rows of v_customers with tier = 'Top 10'. Join every view to v_customers on customer_id for customer_name, region, and segment.
Revenue is SUM(revenue_usd) from v_revenue_monthly. Plan attainment is that revenue divided by SUM(plan_usd) from v_revenue_outlook over the same customers and months.

Periods are whole months and half-open. When no period is given, use the last 12 complete months: month >= add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'MM'), -12) and month < trunc(current_date(), 'MM'). Never include the current partial month in actual revenue.

Next quarter is the calendar quarter after the current one: month >= add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'QUARTER'), 3) and month < add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'QUARTER'), 6). commit_usd and best_case_usd are forecasts and are NULL for past months. The gap to plan is SUM(plan_usd) - SUM(commit_usd) over those months.

Device share is SUM(device_models_with_us) / SUM(device_models) from v_device_footprint for one quarter. Compare the latest quarter (MAX(quarter)) with the quarter four quarters earlier (add_months(latest, -12)).

Lead-to-win conversion is the count of stage = 'Closed Won' divided by the count of stage IN ('Closed Won', 'Closed Lost', 'Disqualified'), over v_pipeline rows whose close_date falls in the period. Open opportunities have stage 'Lead', 'Qualified', 'Proposal', or 'Commit'. Leads are opportunities counted by created_date. amount_usd is the first-year revenue the opportunity would add if won.
An account is at risk when it has a v_customer_signals row with direction = 'risk' and published_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 120).

v_customer_signals rows are market and account intelligence already reduced to a theme. When citing one, give its headline, source_name, and published_date. Never present a signal's summary as a fact about the customer without its source.

v_insights holds the briefing's narrative. scope = 'portfolio' is the top-10 briefing; any other scope is a customer_id. chapter is headline, know, measure, anticipate, or act; act rows are recommendations with title, cause, effect, action, and owner.

examples.question: What themes are the top 10 focused on, and which accounts share each?
examples.sql:
SELECT s.theme, s.direction, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS accounts,
  concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(c.customer_name))) AS account_names
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_customer_signals s
JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.tier = 'Top 10'
GROUP BY s.theme, s.direction
ORDER BY accounts DESC

examples.question: What is next quarter's commit against plan for each top-10 account?
examples.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(o.plan_usd) AS plan_usd, SUM(o.commit_usd) AS commit_usd,
  SUM(o.best_case_usd) AS best_case_usd, SUM(o.plan_usd) - SUM(o.commit_usd) AS gap_to_plan_usd
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_revenue_outlook o
JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.tier = 'Top 10'
  AND o.month >= add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'QUARTER'), 3)
  AND o.month < add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'QUARTER'), 6)
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY gap_to_plan_usd DESC

examples.question: How has each top-10 account's device share changed over the last year?
examples.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(quarter) AS q FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_device_footprint)
SELECT c.customer_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.quarter = l.q THEN f.device_models_with_us END) / SUM(CASE WHEN f.quarter = l.q THEN f.device_models END) AS share_now,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.quarter = add_months(l.q, -12) THEN f.device_models_with_us END) / SUM(CASE WHEN f.quarter = add_months(l.q, -12) THEN f.device_models END) AS share_year_ago
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_device_footprint f
CROSS JOIN latest l
JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.tier = 'Top 10'
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY share_now - share_year_ago

examples.question: Which top-10 contracts end in the next 180 days?
examples.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, k.contract_type, k.end_date, k.annual_value_usd, k.status
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_contracts k
JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.tier = 'Top 10'
  AND k.end_date >= current_date()
  AND k.end_date < date_add(current_date(), 180)
ORDER BY k.end_date

examples.question: What is lead-to-win conversion for the top 10 over the last 12 complete months, by account?
examples.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name,
  COUNT_IF(p.stage = 'Closed Won') / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(p.stage IN ('Closed Won', 'Closed Lost', 'Disqualified')), 0) AS conversion
FROM ${catalog}.${schema}.v_pipeline p
JOIN ${catalog}.${schema}.v_customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.tier = 'Top 10'
  AND p.close_date >= add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'MM'), -12)
  AND p.close_date < trunc(current_date(), 'MM')
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY conversion
